description_excerpt: Role Purpose Establish and scale a newly created SMV specialist capability within the Create pillar. Build and govern operation-level rate cards that support the costing framework, using GSD and other approved work-measurement methods to create consistent, credible and auditable standards. Partner with Product Engineering / Commercialization specialists, Cost Engineering and vendors to validate operation schedules and exceptions. Continually refine standards as products, processes, data and technology evolve, while identifying opportunities to optimize SMV through method improvement,…
